title: Game of Thrones house quiz: which house do you belong to? Free — cv.cm
description: Free Game of Thrones house quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you belong to House Stark, Lannister, Targaryen, Baratheon, Greyjoy, Tyrell, Martell or Tully. Unofficial fan quiz, no spoilers.
lede: Loyal like the Starks, clever like the Lannisters or fearless like the Targaryens? Answer 12 questions about family, power and honor to find your house in Westeros.
about: In Game of Thrones and George R.R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire, each great house has its own sigil, words and character: the honorable Starks of the North (Winter is coming), the rich and cunning Lannisters (Hear me roar), the fiery Targaryens (Fire and blood), the proud Baratheons (Ours is the fury), the sea-going Greyjoys (We do not sow), the elegant Tyrells (Growing strong), the passionate Martells of Dorne (Unbowed, unbent, unbroken) and the loyal Tullys (Family, duty, honor). This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your house and shows your scores for all eight. The questions and results describe each house's values, not story events, so there are no spoilers. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by HBO, Warner Bros. or George R.R. Martin; the names belong to their owners.

items.q: Your idea of a perfect day:

options: Caring a bit too much about appearances

stark.name: House Stark
stark.body: Winter is coming. You are honorable, loyal and steady, from the cold North where people stick together. You'd rather do the right thing than the easy thing, and you protect your pack. Learn to spot people who don't share your values.

lannister.name: House Lannister
lannister.body: Hear me roar. You are clever, ambitious and proud of your family. You plan ahead, understand power and money, and you always pay your debts. Your sharp mind can win any game; make sure you're playing for the right reasons.

targaryen.name: House Targaryen
targaryen.body: Fire and blood. You are bold, passionate and sure you're meant for something big. You inspire people and aren't afraid to fly where others won't. Keep your fire bright, and listen to friends who help you keep it under control.

baratheon.name: House Baratheon
baratheon.body: Ours is the fury. You are strong, energetic and loud in the best way: the first to a fight and the last to leave a feast. You live fully and say what you mean. Just make sure your temper doesn't make your decisions.

greyjoy.name: House Greyjoy
greyjoy.body: We do not sow. You are fearless, independent and drawn to the wild sea. You'd rather take a risk than wait for permission, and you are tougher than most. Find the people worth sailing with, and you'll go far.

tyrell.name: House Tyrell
tyrell.body: Growing strong. You are charming, social and smart in ways people underestimate. You win with grace, good food and better conversation, and you always know who to talk to. Behind the roses there's real strategy.

martell.name: House Martell
martell.body: Unbowed, unbent, unbroken. You are passionate, proud and patient, from sunny Dorne. You enjoy life, value freedom and never forget a wrong; you wait for the right moment to act. Your resilience is your power.

tully.name: House Tully
tully.body: Family, duty, honor. You are loyal, warm and protective, and family always comes first. People know they can rely on you. Remember that looking after yourself is part of looking after the people you love.
